names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 14 ноября ст. ст., name page 14485, «Александр, протоиерей, сщмч.», with the grade word and the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Александра» and gives it without a surname. This is the only one of the twenty-seven whose name link gives no surname at all: the page title is «Александр, протоиерей, сщмч.», so the stored form is the bare forename, which many folders already hold. The surname is not in the source and is not supplied from anywhere else.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 14 ноября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page, so the year it prints at the end of that line is the whole of what is recorded here. No day, no place and no manner of death are given, and none is inferred.
